steps.label: prep
steps.run: mkdir -p "$AGENT_HOME/work/esp_main" && cd "$AGENT_HOME/work/esp_main" && cp "$AGENT_HOME/repo/packs/esp/"* . && rm -rf s && bash prep.sh | head -c 2500

steps.label: stills
steps.run: cd "$AGENT_HOME/work/esp_main" && /Applications/Blender.app/Contents/MacOS/Blender -b esp.blend -P esp_render.py -- stills 50 56,132,204,300,365,465,606,717,802,885,977,1087,1201,1303,1424 > st.log 2>&1; grep -a FRAME st.log | tr '\n' ' '; tail -5 st.log; a="build_info.json esp/e1/build_info.json"; for f in s/f*.jpg; do a="$a $f esp/e1/$(basename $f)"; done; "$AGENT_HOME/node/bin/node" "$AGENT_HOME/repo/tools/push_preview.mjs" $a | tail -2
